explanations.text:
●  you log in once on this machine                    ([the login](cmd_login))
  │     You type human login <key>, the key that was handed to you.
  │     The tool sends the key to the training store and gets back
  │     your user id. [It writes both](login) into one small file in
  │     your home folder, ~/.config/human/credentials.json, that only
  │     you can read. Every later call carries the key from that file.
  │
  ●  the tool knows where the store is             ([the address](store_url))
  │     The store is one web address, held in this file. An address
  │     in the environment, HUMAN_STORE, takes its place for a test.
  │     [The file of the key](credentials_path) can move the same way,
  │     with HUMAN_CREDENTIALS, and [the tool reads it](credentials)
  │     before every call - no file, no user.
  │
  ●  the tool makes one call to the store                ([the call](call))
  │     It sends the method, the path, the key in a header, and the
  │     JSON body when there is one, and waits up to a minute.
  │     An answer that is not 200 comes back as its status and its
  │     words. A store that does not answer at all raises
  │     [one named stop](Unreachable), so the caller chooses: a
  │     retext warns and goes on, an undo refuses.
  │
  ●  the tool asks with your key                          ([the ask](ask))
  │     It reads the key file first: no key, and the ask ends with
  │     [a refusal](Refused) that says to log in. A refusal from the
  │     store comes back the same way, with the store's status and
  │     words, so the command prints them and stops.
  │
  ●  the four roads                          ([the list](list_sessions))
        [The list](list_sessions) gives every session of yours, newest first,
        with its counts. [One session](get_session) comes whole by its id.
        [A put](put_session) sends a whole session, and the store keeps it
        under its id and refreshes the list. [The open one](open_session)
        walks the list for the session not yet finished and brings it
        whole, or nothing.
